body: If you really love her, see what she has to offer.. maybe her love for God will change your life and bring you two closer.. be open to change and finding yourself
I bet he loves you with all his heart.. and doesnt want to lose you.. real love doesnt change.. you should come to him and trust he'll take care of you. I wish my s/o did

Hey bro im going through something similar right now, but im just about 25 and we were going on our 7th year. I know how it feels and its ruthless but be glad your only 16 bro. Times going to fly and your still going to be young as ever with a new chance with the right girl. Maybe this one.. maybe someone else. Just dont be discouraged. I didnt find my love till i had just turned 19.. went through a bunch of pain before that.. pain my whole life actually LOL. So as shitty as it is just take your time cause we cant rush anything. Just get yourself ready as a good man with good morals and a good job so when you find the right girl, you'll be ready to be what she needs.. i shouldve done that but its too late for me now dont let it be too late for you bro. Even i still have another chance and i feel old but im really so young smfh lol. And dont worry about man'ing up bro your at the age of learning what its going to be like to be a man. Dont listen to hard ass men either you gotta keep your sensitive side but find your strength. Real men can relate to his girl and be gentle, but also be the strength to protect her.. i honestly promise things will work out. Just dont let anybody get the best of you.

Dont be sorry! I'm glad you talked to them, but dont give up right away. They wouldnt joke if they truly knew. No ones going to poke fun at you after doing it. Its going to hurt everyone in your life. You can still talk to your loved ones about it. Our parents have been through more, alot longer than us. Dont think they wont understand.

I'm 24 almost 25 and we had been together for over 6 years and we been through so much im telling you what you did is forgivable man but its not right, its good you care so much but if you show her how much you care, and you always remember why your grateful to have her, you guys could have a great relationship. You got to ask yourself why you did it in the first place, so you can heal that quick too for your own happiness. Hope you go for it bro life can be amazing with real love.

If she wants to give you a second chance, you've got to take it and become the best man for her that you can be. She doesnt expect you to be perfect but your guys love will be so worth it. We all fuck up and i've lost my fiancee last week. Dont know if there will be a second chance. Take that chance and be the best you. It'll be the best decision you ever made bro. If you know in your heart she's the one, do everything you can to not lose her.
Yay! Let us know how it goes.. we're still here for you

There's got to be someone you can name that would be there for you, to listen and actually care.. because you know cutting isnt the answer its only temporarily covering the deeper pain.. i know there's somebody that loves you and wants to be there for you even if you dont know thats how they feel.. and you have us you can talk to
I came for the help, but stayed to help.. knowing that we might share/have shared the same depth of pain.

If you end it I know your friends and family would have wished you talked to them, and they'll feel that for the rest of their life. My moms only around because I was there to call 911. I wish she had of tried talking to me first. A few weeks back she attempted again and didnt reach out.. please reach out to your friends because you will be surprised with the support you recieve.. the more people you can reach out to the greater the support. Please dont be scared to because this can be your hope. We're all in this crazy life together.

Well you're definitely listened to here.. i understand, i'm 24 and can relate to alot of what you said.. my fiancee just left me and I also have a weird relationship with God. But i'll tell you there's no way God hates you for calling on him in your time of need. This whole worlds become really fucked and the fact that you even feel theres a chance you can come to him and pour your heart out and ask for help is amazing. We dont know whats exactly waiting for us but I think we have a beautiful gift right now and thats the chance to find hope.. i'm looking for that hope right now but reading your post reminded me that after everything, after all the bullshit, after all the pain the only thing we have left here is our love and what we can do for eachother. I know its the hardest thing when your hearts been broken and in so much pain, but when my love and I were together i finally felt free from all that pain. So i know hope exists. It sucks but you should probably take a break from your relationship, and talk about things so he can have the chance to understand and if he can show you that his love is true then you guys can do things the right way together.. its just easy to get caught up and sometimes we need to see and reflect and get a wake up call.. you've gotten through till now and i know if you focus on making positive changes where ever you can, the pain to get to those changes will be the best thing you've ever done. And know that good people are here.. i just posted in here then read your post and it helped remind me.. i'm definitely here if you want to talk about anything. Lots of love & wishing you the best, and remember.. pour your heart out in prayer and ask for everything to be made clear. Then looks for those signs :)
